## Change and evidence

Describe the problem, change, evidence level, source provenance and limitations.

## Validation

List the offline tests performed. Keep synthetic results separate from device measurements.

## Publication checklist

- [ ] I have the right to contribute this work and identified its license.
- [ ] No proprietary binary, vendor manual, private raw capture or personal identifier is included.
- [ ] Logs are sanitized; no IMEI, ICCID, IMSI, USB serial, credentials or private paths remain.
- [ ] Claims do not imply working end-to-end 5G or a drop-in replacement without evidence.
- [ ] Hardware access remains opt-in; no data session, reset or persistent write occurs by default.
- [ ] Tests and documentation reflect the change.
